dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Aha, where there's fighting, there's accidents. Looks like my services could really be of use here.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: That way, you won't need to relocate the injured. I'll just treat them here.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I'll sit back and admire the lithe human musculature and twisted facial expressions, hehe.
